messages:
zoe.marketing: Quick idea: 9-day "blitz" to launch a tiny OSS refkit + 3 snack tutorials + a reproducible perf note. Goal: GH traction + signups.

sam.devrel: Yes. Tutorials: Quickstart (10m), Latency tuning (12m), Canary rollouts (15m). We'll provide ready-to-run snippets.

kai.eng: I'll run a compact perf harness on g6/g5 — fp16 vs int4, seq=128, batch 1/4. ETA ~24h. ci.bot: bench job queued for 02:00 UTC.

ana.content: I'll draft the launch post and two tweet threads (announce + tech thread). Need bench CSV and a brief engineer quote.

mike.growth: Routing plan: gated download with funnels: enterprise -> SDR, OSS contributors -> devrel nurture, others -> marketing drip.

rebecca.sales: Suggest qualification: company_size >= 60 OR monthly_tokens >= 120000 => SDR. Flag any github_org as high-intent. Escalate mentions of "on-prem" to AE.

zoe.marketing: Hero copy variants to test: A) "Refkit Blitz: a tiny, reproducible starter for LLM features" B) "Bench-backed starter to predict latency and unit cost". We'll A/B test.

sam.devrel: Add a mini-eval notebook and CONTRIBUTING.md so maintainers can reproduce & contribute.

kai.eng: Bench done. Quick summary: g6, int4, batch1, seq128 -> ~2.05x tokens/sec vs fp16. Uploading CSV + runbook to repo.

ana.content: Got the CSV. Draft post will call out exact model, seq len, batch, and repro link. Tone: developer-first, transparent.

mike.growth: Routing pseudocode: ```if paying_customer: route = "acct-exec" elif company_size >= 60 or monthly_tokens >= 120000: route = "sdr" elif github_contrib == true: route = "devrel_nurture" else: route = "marketing_drip"``` Tune after first 100 signups.

rebecca.sales: SDR playbook + qualification doc incoming.

zoe.marketing: Action items: kai -> bench artifacts + runbook (24h), sam -> tutorials + small vids (5d), ana -> post + social drafts (48h), mike -> landing + routing setup (48h), rebecca -> SDR playbook (48h). Quick sync tomorrow to lock publish date. :rocket:
